# ctyun_flow_package (Resource)
-> 管理共享流量包



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

# 可参考index.md，在环境变量中配置ak、sk、资源池ID、可用区名称
provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

# 创建1个月，10G的共享流量包
resource "ctyun_flow_package" "flow_package_test1" {
  cycle_type  = "month"
  spec = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cycle_type` (String) 订购周期类型，取值范围：month（1月），year（1年）
- `spec` (Number) 规格说明：当 cycleType = month 时，10-10GB,50-50GB,100-100GB,500-500GB,1024-1TB,5120-5TB,10240-10TB,51200-50TB;   **当 cycleType = year 时，120-120GB,512-512GB,8192-8TB,36864-36TB,122880-120TB,614400-600TB,1048576-1PB,2097152-2PB

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池ID，如果不填则默认使用provider ctyun中的region_id或环境变量中的CTYUN_REGION_ID

### Read-Only

- `effective_time` (String) 生效时间
- `expire_time` (String) 过期时间
- `id` (String) ID
- `left_volume` (Number) 剩余流量
- `master_resource_id` (String) 主资源ID
- `package_name` (String) 套餐名
- `total_volume` (Number) 总流量
